title: Talent scheduling scratchpad - Maya
content:
Daily scratchpad — quick brain dump (Maya)
Date: 2026-03-13

Top priorities (today):
- ☐ Confirm panel for Elena Park (Backend SWE) — candidate in PST, hiring manager still needs to approve panelers. Deadline: 3/13 EOD.
- ☐ Resend reschedule options to Alex Moreno (PM) — candidate requested morning slots next week (CEST).
- ☐ Finalize offer packet draft for Jordan Lee (SDE2) and share with EVPs for comps; target send 3/14.
- ☐ Close loop w/ Samir Patel (Data Scientist) about take-home feedback — check with interviewers for comments by 16:00 PT.
- ☐ Update Greenhouse statuses for candidates interviewed last week (bulk update).

Morning block (9:00–11:30 PT): scheduling + quick follow-ups
- 9:00 Quick sync with Evan (10m) — confirm panel availability for Elena.
- 9:30 Call w/ hiring manager (Julian) — discuss expectations for on-site loop, note: Julian OOO 3/15–3/16.
- 10:15 Buffer: send calendar invites for confirmed panels. Use 'Redwood Interview' invite template + prep doc link.

Candidate notes (actionable)
- Elena Park — Backend SWE (recruiting: hiring@infra): candidate preferred 11am–1pm PST. Panelers pending: Priya, Marcus, Ops lead (TBD). Action: ping Marcus, Priya; if no reply by 12:30 PT escalate to Julian.
- Alex Moreno — PM (EMEA) — asked to move to morning CEST windows next week. Send 3 options: 09:00, 09:30, 10:30 CEST on Tue/Wed. Include timezone converter link.
- Samir Patel — DS — take-home submitted 3/12; interviewers: Rina, Omar. Action: collect notes in GH issue GH-4321; remind Rina at 14:30 PT.
- Jordan Lee — SDE2 (offer stage) — draft comps using band B2, eq stock 0.3% range (placeholder until comp committee). Blocker: comp committee slot 3/14 11:00 PT.

Templates to copy (shortened)
- Follow-up after phone screen: "Thanks again for your time today — next step is the technical loop. I’ll share 3 calendar options by EOD."
- Reschedule ask: "Thanks for the heads-up. Which of these mornings works for you? (links) — if none, share 2 times that work and I’ll coordinate."
- Offer pre-send: "Hi Jordan — finalizing offer details. Expect email from me with formal packet by tomorrow; quick Qs: target start date? visa sponsorship?"

Operational reminders
- Block 30m later for Greenhouse bulk status updates (post-standup).
- Check background-check vendor status for hires from last cycle (GreenTeam). If any pending >48h, escalate to People Ops lead.
- Update "interviewer availability" doc with new recurring slots (link to console).

Housekeeping / personal bits
- Slack reminders: set DM to self for 15:00 PT to follow up on Jordan comp committee.
- Lunch: 12:30 PT (don’t forget!).
- Quick note to self: keep a 10-minute buffer between scheduling calls — avoid overflow.

Open questions / blockers
- Who is backup paneler for Elena if Ops lead unavailable? -> Ask Julian or Marcus.
- Offer approval queue: do we need legal review for Jordan (eq >0.25%)? Check with legal@redwood.

End-of-day checklist (EOD)
- ☐ All confirmed panels have calendar invites + prep doc attached.
- ☐ Greenhouse statuses updated for interviewed candidates.
- ☐ Offer draft sent to comp reviewers (if ready).
- ☐ Slack summary to #recruiting with highlight candidates and blockers.

Quick log (timestamps)
- 09:05 — pinged Marcus + Priya about Elena.
- 09:18 — scheduled 1:1 with Julian for 09:30.
- 10:02 — sent reschedule options to Alex (w/ timezone links).

Random notes for future templates
- Add a short "what to expect" paragraph in initial invite: length, format, remote instructions, contact person.
- Build a canned message for international timezone conversions (how to present options without confusion).

---
Notes to self: breathe, prioritize high-impact candidate movement first, batch follow-ups in 2x 20-min blocks to avoid context switching.
